title: fix(fields): a lookup whose record read is refused draws the restricted-record placeholder, not a linked raw id
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbXsaGxtGer5XYc7Y7N6hJir)_ Fixes #29641 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6592434215 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:lookup 字段单元格在读取被引用记录时,如果服务端以「无权限」拒绝(403 或 `PERMISSION_DENIED`),现在显示「受限记录」占位:不显示原始 id、不带链接,与「记录不存在」(404)同一外观;拒绝结果会缓存,同一记录只读一次。网络错误、5xx、401 等其他失败保持原来的「未解析」外观(id + 问号)。 - 为什么改:目标对象的读权限拒绝读者时,服务端对记录读取回 403 而不是 404,单元格把它当成读取失败,画出带链接的原始 id,点进去是一个拒绝访问的页面,看起来像坏数据。 - 风险与回滚:只改 `useLookupName` 的 catch 分支,判定复用 `@object-ui/react` 已有的 `classifyLoadError`(`forbidden`),不改数据适配器、不改 `findOne` 的返回值;404 占位、可读记录、在途读取的外观全部不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` 的 `useLookupName` catch 分支与 `refused` 缓存状态;新测试 `lookupCell.forbiddenRead-29641.test.tsx`。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/lookupCell.forbiddenRead-29641.test.tsx`,预期 12 个用例全部通过。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes A lookup cell names its referenced record by reading it as the viewer (`useLookupName`, `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`). objectui#13335 drew a record the read answered "not found" (`findOne` answers `null`, the adapter's 404) as "Restricted record", with no id and no link. When the target object's read gate refuses the viewer, the server answers the same read with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, which the adapter throws, and the hook caught every throw as a failure: the cell drew the raw id beside a question mark, inside a link to a record page that refuses the viewer. | The viewer's read of the referenced record | Before | Now | |---|---|---| | answers `null` (404, hidden by sharing or missing) | Restricted record, no link | unchanged | | throws a refusal: status 403 (`httpStatus`, `status` or `statusCode`) or code `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `FORBIDDEN` | the id with a question mark, linked | Restricted record, no id, no link; cached, read once | | throws anything else (network, 5xx, 401) | the id with a question mark | unchanged | - The refusal is read through `@object-ui/react`'s `classifyLoadError` (`forbidden`), which `@object-ui/fields` already depends on and imports; no new predicate and no message matching. The lookup cache gains a `refused` state, which the hook answers as `absent`, so `LookupCellRenderer` is unchanged apart from a comment. - Measured live before the edit (`pnpm dev:crm`, a member refused `rnv_payroll`): the adapter's `findOne` throws a plain `Error` whose own members are `httpStatus: 403`, `code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED'` and `details` (`error`, `code`, `object`), with no `status` / `statusCode`; `classifyLoadError` answers `forbidden` on it. A missing id under the same object answers the same 403, so the placeholder discloses nothing a not-found would not. - `user` cells: unchanged. `UserCellRenderer` never reads the referenced person (a bare id is `UnresolvedUserReference`), so it has no read answer to classify. - Not changed: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and what `findOne` returns. ## Tests - `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/lookupCell.forbiddenRead-29641.test.tsx` (new, 12): the measured 403 draws the placeholder with no id in text or attributes, no anchor, one `findOne` and no `find`; the four single spellings (`httpStatus`, `status`, `statusCode` 403, code `PERMISSION_DENIED`) each draw it; the refusal is cached (a second cell for the same id draws it with no read) and a 502 on another id afterwards keeps the unresolved face; in a multi-value cell only the first, read entry is restricted. CONTROLS: a `null` answer keeps the placeholder; a 500 with a code, a 503, a network `TypeError` and a 401 each keep the unresolved face with their id. - Unchanged and green: `lookupCell.restrictedRecord-13335.test.tsx`, `lookupCell.referenceNameVisible-29462.test.tsx`, the other lookupCell files and `DetailSection.referenceNameVisible-29462.test.tsx`: 12 files, 97 tests. - Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty), run on the new file plus the #13335 file: A1 the catch records every throw as `err`: 7 failed / 14 passed; A2 the `refused` entry no longer answers `absent`: 7 failed / 14 passed. The 7 are exactly the refusal cases; every control stays green. ## Acceptance notes - Seat additions honoured: the cache pin (refusal cached like a not-found, no cross-key bleed to a later transient failure) is the third test above. - The cell's `useRefObjectSchema` reads the target's object definition (`/meta/object/rnv_payroll`) before and after this change alike; it is not part of the record read and is left as it is. - Local gates on the final head `214f2289` (main merged twice; none of the merged commits touches `ui/packages/fields`): `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 35; all 35 exit 0 (33 in an unlocked loop, `check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files) under the verify lock); `--ran`: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The same 35 also exit 0 on the earlier head `647dc13a`. `ui/scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` exit 0 (PR #29623 edits the same file's `ReferenceNameOnlyValue`; this diff stays clear of it). `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/fields` exit 0 (48 tasks). `@object-ui/fields` suite: 296 files passed, 1 skipped, 4449 tests. eslint on the two touched ui files: 0 errors. The repo-wide sweep is CI's. ## Verification
Live, pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh plus the source Console (Vite), a member refused the payroll object - Setup is the #29462 recipe: a scratch package `com.example.rnv` with `rnv_payroll` (private, admin-owned) and `rnv_expense` (`public_read`) carrying `Payroll (no key)`, a lookup without `referenceNameVisible`; a member granted read on `rnv_expense` only, impersonated. `GET /api/v1/data/rnv_payroll/ID` as the member: 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. - Before (main `fc558923`): list and record page each draw `Payroll (no key)` as the unresolved face with the id, inside a link to `rnv_payroll` (1 anchor). - After (this branch): list and record page each draw "Restricted record" for it, not inside a link, and no anchor to `rnv_payroll` remains. The `referenceNameVisible` fields still draw their served names as text. Screenshots and the per-page readings are in the project folder (`issue-29641/shots/`), not on GitHub.
